title: Southwest coastal lookouts
caption: The south promenade now reaches two sea lookouts, six usable benches and a pine rest bay with jumping stones, ending at a clear northern maintenance boundary.

sections.title: Finished southwest coast
sections.caption: Final committed native morning/evening views of the promenade, lookouts, pine rest bay and maintenance boundary; phone 390×844 and desktop 1366×860.

sections.title: Matched before
sections.caption: Same nine positions before the work, on f80c486df with runtime identical to f1eef49a2. Native camera bounds alone extended to frame the formerly unreachable corner.

sections.title: Final physical route, seating and jumping
sections.caption: Actual walking and running through the widened support bypass, both lookouts, seats, jump detour and return. Both native sizes passed on f55fe58ba.

sections.title: Repaired railway: structural close-ups
sections.caption: All 16 structural diagnostic views passed independent visual review at 8/10. Shed running-track and outer-track positions deliberately stand outside public walks to inspect joints; actor occlusion there is diagnostic.

sections.title: Northern lookout lamp repair
sections.caption: Moved the lamp along the inland verge so its bright head and pole clear Eric in the phone standing view. Superseded by the complete final set.

sections.title: Before lamp and curve repairs
sections.caption: The crowd-clear inland turn worked, but review found a northern phone lamp overlap and torn curved railway joints in structural close-ups. Both repaired in the final set.

sections.title: First complete coast
sections.caption: Usable terraces and physical route. Superseded by the crowd-clear turn, lamp and continuous curve repairs.

sections.title: Original baseline framing
sections.caption: Retained original views; the first desktop heading was wrong and corrected in before-matched.

sections.title: Corrected original baseline
sections.caption: Corrected native desktop headings before the final southern lookout relocation.

sections.title: New lookout location before work
sections.caption: Matched baseline at the open seaward pocket chosen after the railway occlusion tests.

sections.title: First coast attempt: rejected lookout
sections.caption: Approach and rest bay were promising, but the southern lookout stood under the railway. Rejected and relocated.

sections.title: Railway fade experiment: rejected
sections.caption: Camera fading detached the beam visually from its support heads. Rejected; all fading removed.

sections.title: Further railway fade probe: rejected
sections.caption: Rejected camera-fade experiment. Final railway is solid from every viewpoint.

sections.title: Solid railway, old lookout: rejected
sections.caption: Headroom and fitted bearings improved, but the old lookout still lay under the outer track. Rejected location.

sections.title: Open lookout clearance probe
sections.caption: Confirmed full native camera and capsule clearance in the seaward pocket before moving the canonical terrace.

sections.title: Railway close-ups before joint repair
sections.caption: Structural diagnostic views exposed triangular gaps between independently rotated beam segments. Rejected and repaired with a continuous profile sweep.

sections.title: Physical route attempt 1
sections.caption: Retained failed route exposed a pine blocking the walking line; canonical planting moved clear.

sections.title: Physical route attempt 2
sections.caption: Retained failed route exposed a lamp in the walking line; canonical lamp moved clear.

sections.title: Physical route attempt 3
sections.caption: Retained failed route exposed insufficient beam headroom; running top retained while the beam underside and fitted bearings were corrected.

sections.title: Physical route attempt 4
sections.caption: Retained failed route identified the actual support head collider. The planner and visible path now pass around its footprint.

sections.title: First complete physical route
sections.caption: Both native sizes passed movement, lookout/rest seats, jumping and return before the crowd-grid widening.

sections.title: Crowd-clear inland route
sections.caption: Both native sizes passed the wider inland bypass, lookout/rest seats, jumping and return. Superseded by final geometry recheck.

sections.title: All six seats and initial fence input
sections.caption: All six seats passed approach/sit/stand at both sizes. Initial fence input moved away from the fence and is invalid; retained and superseded by fence-input-2.

sections.title: Corrected boundary input
sections.caption: Held northward run and jump stop at the maintenance fence at both native sizes; no unfinished northern access.

sections.title: Held running and jumping under the railway
sections.caption: Native held run and jump cross the real beam/support bypass at both sizes; solid beam, no fading.

sections.title: Triangle diagnosis: failed filter
sections.caption: Retained diagnostic view. Its first inventory filter referenced a nonexistent camera property and collected no rows; corrected in profile 2.

sections.title: Combined triangle diagnosis
sections.caption: Actual offending north-facing camera on combined f812bb801. Large district-wide merged statics drew the seaward coast unnecessarily.

sections.title: Matched triangle baseline
sections.caption: Same north-facing diagnostic camera before the southwest work. Separate regional desktop meshes now preserve every vertex while allowing correct culling.
